run_tracer_sanity_check: run the check_tracer_sanity script to verify all gRPC tracers are documented in environment_variables.md
extract_tracer_names: extract GRPC_TRACER_INITIALIZER macro names from C source files in src/core using regex pattern matching
walk_c_source_files: walk the src/core directory recursively to find all .c files for tracer macro scanning
validate_tracer_documentation: validate that every tracer found in C source files is mentioned in doc/environment_variables.md
check_regex_pattern: check C source files against the GRPC_TRACER_INITIALIZER regex pattern to find tracer initializer declarations
